morphology.pattern_note: 单音节独立词，无词缀交替；以下词族项目为复合术语。

senses.zh_definition: 杆：传统英制长度单位，约等于5.03米。
senses.en_definition: A traditional unit of length equal to approximately 5.03 metres; a pole or perch.
senses.ms_definition: Ukuran panjang tradisional yang bersamaan dengan kira-kira 5.03 meter; pol.
senses.nuances: 此义对应 rod I。[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=rod) 网页及输入包中的16 kaki、5 ela与5.03米并不相等；标准换算为16.5英尺、5.5码，即5.0292米，见[NIST换算表](https://www.nist.gov/pml/us-surveyfoot/revised-unit-conversion-factors)。马来文释义为据词典整理的表述。

senses.zh_definition: 棒；杆：由木材、金属等制成的直长条状物，通常呈圆柱形。
senses.en_definition: A straight, slender bar of wood, metal, or another material, typically cylindrical.
senses.ms_definition: Batang daripada kayu, logam dan sebagainya yang lurus, biasanya berbentuk bulat.
senses.nuances: 此义对应 rod II，常用于科学及机械语境，如玻璃棒、连杆；具体材质或用途通常由后置修饰语说明。依据[DBP词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=rod)整理。

dual_scenarios.ms: Larutan itu dikacau menggunakan rod kaca yang bersih.
dual_scenarios.zh: 使用洁净的玻璃棒搅拌该溶液。
dual_scenarios.en: The solution is stirred using a clean glass rod.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Rod kaca tu dah bersih ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah rod kaca itu sudah bersih?
dual_scenarios.zh: 那根玻璃棒已经干净了吗？
dual_scenarios.en: Is that glass rod clean yet?

messages.speaker: Farah (同学)
messages.ms_spoken: Rod kaca tu dah bersih ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah rod kaca itu sudah bersih?
messages.zh: 那根玻璃棒已经干净了吗？
messages.en: Is that glass rod clean yet?

messages.speaker: Amir (同学)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, saya letak kat atas meja tadi.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, rod kaca itu sudah bersih. Saya meletakkannya di atas meja tadi.
messages.zh: 干净了，我刚才把它放桌上了。
messages.en: Yes, I put it on the table just now.

etymology.historical_story: The two dictionary senses connect a physical rod with an established surveying measure. A straight bar is an everyday object, while a rod as a unit belongs to older systems of measuring land. Malay dictionaries preserve both meanings, making context essential when interpreting technical instructions or historical measurements. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=rod).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把rod想成一根直杆：实验室里是棒，旧测量记录里是一杆长，约5米。
